claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the model for launch is compliant and evidentially supported despite a known below-target public-benefits eligibility segment, based on aggregate readiness, monitored limited rollout, and disclosure/monitoring controls.

concern_ledger.concern: Required pre-launch disclosure for the exposed public benefits eligibility limitation is not evidenced.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final model-card or equivalent pre-launch disclosure artifact explicitly documenting the limitation for the launch use case.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy makes disclosure a required predicate when the named launch use case remains exposed and there is no approved risk acceptance.

concern_ledger.concern: The only risk-acceptance artifact is an unapproved draft that does not mention the relevant exposure.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Approved risk-acceptance record that specifically addresses the public benefits eligibility exposure and explains why continued exposure is acceptable.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Unapproved and non-specific risk acceptance cannot substitute for the disclosure/approval requirement under policy.

concern_ledger.concern: The rollout plan leaves the affected segment in scope.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Admissible evidence of cohort exclusion for the affected segment, or approved risk acceptance, or completed required disclosure before launch.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy text says rollout controls mitigate only if they exclude the affected use case or are paired with reviewed risk acceptance; current evidence shows neither.

decision_criteria: A compliant certification requires admissible evidence that the exposed limitation was either resolved, excluded from rollout, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
If the affected use case remains exposed, monitored rollout and rollback controls can support deployment only alongside the required disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not by themselves satisfy the model-card disclosure policy.
evidence_requests: Provide the final pre-launch model card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the exposed public benefits eligibility limitation was explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance that specifically addresses the public benefits eligibility exposure, if certification is being justified without disclosure-based mitigation.
Provide evidence that the initial rollout cohort excludes the affected use case, if exclusion is being claimed as the basis for compliance.
specific_concerns: The affected public benefits eligibility segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
Policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The available risk-acceptance draft is unapproved and does not address the exposed public benefits eligibility segment.
No admissible evidence shows the required pre-launch model-card disclosure has actually been completed.
Rollout controls, small percentage launch, and rollback capability do not satisfy the policy predicate by themselves when the affected segment remains exposed.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify the model is not fully supported because there is no admissible evidence that the required pre-launch disclosure exists.
Any implication that rollout controls alone cure or offset the disclosure duty is unsupported by the policy text and contradicted by the stated policy context.
